scope: D05 registration and attachment code fixes; local service/browser verification plus read-only customer attachment parsing.
changes: Attachment parser reuses existing HTTPS validation without requiring the browser URL global; preserves the original signed URL and rejects empty names and unsafe addresses.
Retrying an attachment upload clears obsolete form errors while preserving uncertain-submission warnings and the reload requirement.
D05 browser transport now exports and invokes the existing D13 recovery write guard; failure output includes page errors and preview logs.

failures: Valid signed link rejected without URL.

beforeFix.browserRetry: After a successful attachment retry, the obsolete upload-failed alert was still rendered; the new assertion failed 1 !== 0 before the fix.
beforeFix.browserAdapter: Initial page could not load because the test transport omitted setWechatRecoveryGuard.

checks: single project defaults correctly; missing leader, invalid phone, missing material and failed upload show visible feedback at 320px without submitting
320px and 390px form sections, files and buttons have no horizontal overflow and text is at least 14px
cancel confirmation writes nothing; submission failure stays visible and blocks duplicate submissions until explicit reload; retry reaches pending review
approval uses the current event player range and requires material confirmation; each missing or invalid field shows nearby visible feedback at 320px without writing a review
registration submitted under 5–18 is approved for 2 players after the event changes to 2–18; original submission and approval ranges are both retained and the leader can read the result
a detail left open during another settings change reloads current rules before validation; 2 players is rejected after tightening to 4–18, with no review write
admin can edit event configuration, reject with reason and release a place; leader sees rejection
uncertain review failures show a visible reload action and disable repeat decisions until reloaded; a confirmed retry approves exactly once and displays the result
resubmission returns to review; verified player count and approval feed the final participant list
editing approved information clears approval; cancellation requires confirmation and releases capacity
my registrations restores private records and deadline locks self-service actions
read failures hide stale records and recover through explicit retry
authenticated maintenance previews without deletion, removes expired temporary files, and retains submitted material at desktop/390/320 widths
browser.scope: Real Vue pages and actual registration, attachment, competition and admin handlers over an isolated transactional store. File chooser and WeChat transport are test-only adapters; not native/cloud validation.

concurrency: Duplicate review and lost committed response are idempotent.
Failed review writes roll back together.

attachmentLifecycle.storage: Isolated transactional memory store and byte map; actual service handlers.

nativeReadonly.validation: Current source parser evaluated in the signed-in WeChat simulator with a current-owner cloud-authorized attachment. Read-only cloud calls and HTTPS bytes via wx.request.
limitations: No native document opening or physical phone test.
An earlier wx.downloadFile attempt reached a temporary file but filesystem cleanup was denied by the automation runtime; it is simulator-managed temporary storage.
No new cloud registration submission, review, cancellation or cleanup.

remaining: Update the client and existing local admin with the patch; physical iPhone/Android file selection, download and native document opening remain unverified.
Customer-cloud review concurrency and replacement/cancellation/re-registration cleanup require a separate scoped business write acceptance.
Second real-account login and reverse cross-account checks remain separate from the existing single-runtime ownership rejection evidence.
Bound historical files are retained; no historical attachment viewer was implemented.
Earlier wx.downloadFile test reached simulator temporary storage, but filesystem access/cleanup was denied; it is not counted as a complete native file workflow.
